entries.text: your zodiac sign is why your ex is like that. yes, yours too.
water signs invented crying in the car. fire signs invented the reason.
earth signs don't fall in love. they run a background check that catches feelings.
mercury retrograde is over. you can no longer blame the planet. the texts were you.
"i don't believe in astrology" said the gemini, doing the most gemini thing possible
the zodiac isn't real until a scorpio guesses your entire personality in one look
dating without knowing their sign is just gambling with extra steps
your soulmate's sign is the one you swore you would never date again
fire signs: act first, think never. water signs: feel first, text at 2am. air signs: think first, vanish. earth signs: plan first, love forever.
somewhere out there your rising sign is ruining a first impression on your behalf
every friend group has a virgo mom, a libra lawyer, a sagittarius flight risk, and a leo cult leader
checking his sign before the first date isn't judgy. it's due diligence.
